basic_info.description: Remodeled and fabulous! Single family home lifestyle in prime Glen Park Village. Behind the stunning facade is fully detached living on all four sides on a pleasantly large lot, boasting great light and a tremendous walkout garden with patios. Recent reno w gleaming new Kit & Baths, newer systems, wood floors & dble paned windows. Spacious Kit features copious cabinet space, slick contemporary quartz counters, SS apps w gas stove, hood & b/fast island w bar stool seating. Tiled bathrooms offer large walk-in glass shower & shower over tub, large marble top sink vanities & cool lighting. Main level living offers 3 Beds, Liv Rm options, Kit, Din Rm & bathrooms. 2 rooms up offer additional use options such as Fam Rm & Home Office. Ground flr media room & home office - or workout studio - is nice additional space. Garage parking with washer/dryer laundry area. Just a few blocks to coffee shops & restos in the heart of the Village & to Glen Park BART station. Great transportation options also include multiple MUNI's & convenient freeway access for South Bay or Downtown commutes.
